context.problem_statement: Evaluate a Random Forest classifier using 5-fold stratified cross-validation on an imbalanced dataset. Steps: (1) apply StratifiedKFold to preserve class proportions in each fold, (2) for each fold, compute: accuracy, balanced accuracy, macro F1-score, and ROC AUC, (3) report mean and standard deviation of each metric across 5 folds, (4) compare StratifiedKFold results to regular KFold results to show why stratification matters for imbalanced data, (5) produce a learning curve (training vs validation accuracy as function of training set size from 20% to 100%).
context.expert_knowledge: StratifiedKFold maintains class ratio in each fold; critical for imbalanced data. Balanced accuracy = average of per-class recall. Use sklearn.model_selection.StratifiedKFold, cross_val_score. Random Forest: RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42). For imbalanced data, balanced_accuracy is more informative than accuracy. Learning curve: sklearn.model_selection.learning_curve.
